tone.target: dark clean chorus with delay and reverb
tone.profile: dark clean chorus with delay and reverb
tone.summary: A highly modulated, atmospheric signal chain built around a clean Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) combined with Chorus, Digital Delay, and Plate Reverb to achieve The Cure's signature dark, ethereal sound.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Smooth out dynamics and provide a gentle clean attack.
blocks.gap: The Comp is used to emulate the smooth, sustained feel of a clean signal without adding grit.

blocks.purpose: Bypass WAH to keep the signal clean and focused on modulation.
Ensure a completely clean signal path; no distortion needed.
Provide the clean, bright Fender-style foundation (JC-120 emulation).
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the closest model to a classic clean Fender tone.

blocks.purpose: Ground the clean tone with a classic American cabinet sound.
Create the signature stereo chorus effect central to The Cure's sound.
Provide a dark, spacious reverb tail (Hall/Plate emulation).
blocks.gap: The Plate is chosen for its smooth decay and ability to add depth without sounding overly bright.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic dark, spacious clean tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance the vintage character of the US Deluxe amp and match the JC-120 clean sound.
